page.layout: One page of text in a single column, running head above it. Below the text, faint show-through from the other side of the leaf (not printed text). A woodcut ornament sits in the centre of the lower page. A gathering signature "N.iiij." stands at the right beside the text.

main_text.p: Similam & farinam summis tantùm digitis apprehensam, pro pane in Cœna Domini accipiunt Basaniani[?], Similitæ.
Præter duo signa à Christo instituta, alia addunt, nempe aquam, Aquarij, Papistæ:caseum, Artotyritæ.
Sine pœnitentia quoslibet peccatores, etiam sceleratissimos homines, ad Cœnam Domini admittunt Audiani.

page.notes: The woodcut in the centre of the lower page is an ornamental figure (a grotesque figure with scrollwork), not text. The faint printed block below the main text is show-through from the reverse side and is left out. The reading "Basaniani" is uncertain: the word is marked [?]. No page number is printed. The signature "N.iiij." is set mid-page at the right, beside the text, not at the foot.
